status: frozen 2026-10-14 with the researcher's decisions (every recommended setting of proposal draft 1, §12); governs Stage 0 (build and validation) and the Stage 1 pilot only. The confirmation protocol and budget are finalized after the pilot and may tighten, never loosen, these definitions.

parent_study.stage2: analysed once 2026-10-10; never re-run or re-analysed
parent_study.inherits: every definition not named here (four cells per target, answer-only loss, chat-template prompt, absent-fact probes, 3 queries per document, refusals score 0, six-outcome classification, margins 0.05, paired target bootstrap, crossed article-cluster utility bootstrap)

decisions.1_training_method: LoRA for every new cell, plus the full fine-tuning replication cell A-full
decisions.2_tier: tier 1: A-full, A-LoRA, Q-1.5B, Q-3B, Llama-1B, Synth, Non-IID; Qwen 7B not run
decisions.3_targets: 30 per cell; the same 30 fresh final SQuAD targets (eligible indices 60-89) in every SQuAD cell
decisions.4_families: Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct (gated: licence acceptance and a Hugging Face token on the server); Gemma-2-2B and the Granite hybrid are tier 2, not run
decisions.5_data: self-generated synthetic private records; DuoRC is tier 2, not run
decisions.7_attacker: the parent's frozen Reference choices (RG record, CB-AO template, F1 scorer) everywhere, plus online LiRA (16 shared shadows per arm, fixed variance); offline LiRA and RMIA secondary
decisions.8_controls: positive controls in every cell with a new model, dataset or training method
decisions.9_federation: in-process FedAvg for LoRA cells, with Flower's aggregation arithmetic; tested bit-identical to the Flower path on full parameters
decisions.10_measurements: lean: utility on W1 only, without no-context and public-library F1
decisions.11_error_control: one Bonferroni family per research question
decisions.12_not_repeated: no causal attack (H2), no DP (H6), no RG-public (H5); P0 descriptive per cell
decisions.decided: 2026-10-14, the researcher: 'Use all the recommended settings'

lora.targets: every attention and MLP projection (all Linear/Conv1D modules except the LM head)

data.squad: the parent build, unchanged (library, F, N, P identical to Stage 2)

synth.layout: the parent's LAYOUT and SIZES; passages 24-160 words; every record fits 512 tokens

non_iid.construction: per client, article proportions ~ Dirichlet(alpha); records drawn without replacement client by client; the target or its hold record joins client 0

seeds.V_targets: 8100 + the target's slot in the new V slices (control, pilot, smoke)

v_slices: after every slice the parent used: datastore = the parent's first 60 V targets (P0 only); then control 12 (study token count >= 80), pilot 4, smoke 1

lean.reference: both forms, with raw model and reference NLLs and token counts
lean.nq: 3 probes per document per cell, F1 and entailment scorers
lean.utility: RAG F1 on F, W1 only
lean.population: 32 U records scored in both forms in every world and shadow

measurements.reference_model: full fine-tuning: the pretrained model (fp32); LoRA: the same base with adapters switched off

lira.design: balanced pairs: each target IN in exactly half the shadows; fill from T excluding every target passage
lira.statistic: phi = -(mean NLL x scored tokens) in the frozen form; online LiRA, fixed (pooled) variance
secondary: RMIA with OUT shadows as references and U records as population

datastore_check.rule: the parent's: 60 V targets, P0, library in vs out; a scorer passes if its pooled AUC 95% lower bound >= 0.70; otherwise H3 is not evaluable in that cell

positive_control.setup: 12 V targets, paired RG worlds; W1's adapters additionally trained on the passage text (full LM loss), 6 steps at lr 1e-3; one rerun at 12 steps if fewer than 10 learn
positive_control.learning_check: the parent's: passage NLL ratio <= 0.5 and continuation match >= 0.5
positive_control.decisive: mean retention 95% lower bound > 0.05 F1 on learned targets -> H4 primary in the cell; otherwise H4 secondary

smoke.jobs: one V target x {RG, CB-AO} lean paired jobs plus one shadow world per arm
smoke.learning_check: LoRA cells: RG's mean client loss falls from round 1 to round 3 and RG's V RAG F1 >= P0's V F1 + 0.05; one rerun at lr 5e-4; a second failure drops the cell

stage0.template: per model: the rendered prompt is identical on repeated calls (Llama's date pinned) and the assistant turn ends with EOS
stage0.token_fit: every record of every job fits 512 tokens untruncated under the cell's tokenizer; a refusal stops the cell

decides: LiRA form per arm (record or template; highest pooled tuning AUC, ties to template), applied in every cell

statistics.unit: target; paired target bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20261012); one index matrix shared by every SQuAD cell
statistics.ceiling_floor: an AUC endpoint is not informative when both arms' 95% lower bounds >= 0.95 or both upper bounds <= 0.55

budget_gpu_hours.note: rough; re-costed from the smoke timings before Stage 2 is frozen
